blocks.text: Qizil kitobda (→ qizil kitob, 8-dars) know, like, want kabi fe'llar Continuous da ishlatilmasligini ko'rgan edik. Sababi: Continuous harakatning **o'rtasini** ko'rsatadi (→ 1-dars), lekin ba'zi fe'llar harakat emas, **holat**ni bildiradi. Bilish, xohlash, ega bo'lish boshlanib-tugaydigan jarayon emas — u shunchaki **bor**. Shuning uchun bunday fe'llar gap «hozir» haqida bo'lsa ham Present Simple da keladi: **I know** the answer (hozir bilaman). O'zbekchada esa ko'pincha «-yap» ishlatiladi: «Tushunyapman», «Eshityapman» — inglizchaga shu shaklni ko'chirish eng ko'p uchraydigan xato.

rows: know, understand, believe, realise, suppose, mean, remember, forget, recognise
like, love, hate, want, need, prefer, mind
own, belong, contain, consist of, include, have (= ega)
seem, appear, sound, look like, resemble

items.text: **I don't understand** why the flight is so expensive.
This bag **belongs** to the woman in the blue coat.
**Do** you **want** me to wait for you outside?

blocks.text: Ikki ma'noli fe'llar: holat va harakat

Ba'zi fe'llarning bir ma'nosi holat, boshqasi — harakat. Holat ma'nosida ular Simple, harakat ma'nosida Continuous da keladi. **think**: fikrim shunday (= believe) — I **think** you're right; o'ylab ko'ryapman (= consider) — I**'m thinking** about it. **What do you think?** — «Fikringiz qanday?», **What are you thinking about?** — «Nimani o'ylayapsiz?». **have**: ega bo'lmoq, bor — She **has** two brothers; lekin have breakfast / a shower / a party / a good time / a baby / problems — harakat: She**'s having** a shower.

rows: The doctor **is feeling** his arm. (ushlab ko'ryapti)

blocks.text: **see** alohida e'tiborga loyiq. «Ko'zim bilan ko'ryapman» ma'nosida — Simple, ko'pincha **can** bilan: I **can see** the sea. «Tushunaman» — **I see**. Lekin «uchrashmoq, qabuliga bormoq» — Continuous: I**'m seeing** the dentist at four. «Biror kishi bilan yurmoq» ham: Aziz **is seeing** someone. **hear** ham shunday: I **can hear** music (eshityapman); **I hear** you're leaving (eshitishimcha, ketyapsan).

items.text: **I think** Aziz is right about the budget.
**I'm thinking** about what Aziz said at the meeting.
**I can see** the Tien Shan from the top floor of our office.
items.translation: Ofisimizning eng yuqori qavatidan Tyan-Shan tog'lari **ko'rinadi**.

blocks.text: is selfish va is being selfish

**be** odatda Simple: He **is** selfish — bu uning **xarakteri**. Lekin hozirgi **xatti-harakat** haqida gapirsak — **is being**: He**'s being** selfish — U hozir (bugun, shu vaziyatda) o'zini xudbinlarcha tutyapti; odatda u bunday emas. Bu shakl faqat xatti-harakatni bildiruvchi sifatlar bilan: silly, rude, careful, polite, lazy, nice, kind, difficult, unreasonable. Holat sifatlari bilan mumkin emas: «I'm being tired / hungry / ill» ✗ → I**'m** tired.

items.text: Bekzod **is being** extra careful because the road is icy.
items.translation: Yo'l muzlagani uchun Bekzod alohida **ehtiyot bo'lyapti**.

blocks.text: look, feel, hurt: ikkalasi ham mumkin

Ba'zi fe'llarda farq deyarli yo'q. «Ko'rinmoq» ma'nosidagi **look**: You **look** tired / You**'re looking** tired. «O'zini his qilmoq» ma'nosidagi **feel**: How **do** you **feel**? / How **are** you **feeling**? Og'riq haqida: My knee **hurts** / My knee **is hurting**. Lekin **feel** «fikrda bo'lmoq» ma'nosida faqat Simple: I **feel** that we should wait.

O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «I'm understanding you.» → **I understand** you. («Tushunyapman» — o'zbekchada -yap, inglizchada Simple); «I'm knowing him.» → **I know** him.; «This bag is belonging to me.» → This bag **belongs** to me.; «I'm needing help.» → **I need** help.; «I'm seeing the mountains.» → **I can see** the mountains.; «I'm being tired.» → **I'm** tired. (being faqat xatti-harakat uchun); «I think about moving» (hozir o'ylab yuribman ma'nosida) → **I'm thinking** about moving.

O'zbekchada «-yap» eshitsangiz ham shoshilmang: avval inglizcha fe'l **harakat**mi yoki **holat**mi, aniqlang. «Ko'ryapman, eshityapman, tushunyapman, bilyapman, yoqyapti, kerak bo'lyapti» — deyarli doim Simple (yoki can see / can hear). Ikki ma'noli fe'lda o'zingizdan so'rang: bu yerda **bir harakatni bajaryapmanmi** (tatib ko'ryapman, uchrashyapman) yoki **holatni aytyapmanmi** (ta'mi bor, ko'zimga ko'rinyapti)?

Holat fe'llari Perfect zamonlarda ham Continuous olmaydi: I**'ve known** her for years («I've been knowing» ✗) — → 10–11-darslar. have va have got → 17-dars. I**'m seeing** the doctor tomorrow kabi kelishilgan rejalar → 19-dars. Reklamadagi «I'm loving it» — so'zlashuv uslubi, uni qolip sifatida olmang.

rows: know, understand, believe, mean, want, need, prefer, belong, contain, cost, depend, seem
think, have, see, taste, smell, weigh, feel (= ushlamoq)
look (= ko'rinmoq), feel (= his qilmoq), hurt, ache

examples.title: Likes, wants and needs: **want**, **need**, **prefer**
examples.description: His-tuyg'u va istak fe'llari — like, love, hate, want, need, prefer, mind — gap «hozir» haqida bo'lsa ham Simple. O'zbekchadagi «xohlayapman», «kerak bo'lyapti» ga aldanmang.

sentences.text: **I need** a bigger suitcase — this one **doesn't hold** enough for two weeks.
sentences.translation: Menga kattaroq chamadon **kerak** — bunisiga ikki haftalik narsa **sig'maydi**.

sentences.text: **Do** you **want** a lift to the station? It's pouring with rain.
sentences.translation: Vokzalgacha **olib borib qo'yaymi**? Yomg'ir chelaklab quyyapti.

sentences.text: Madina **prefers** working in the morning, when the office is quiet.
sentences.translation: Madina ofis jimjit bo'ladigan ertalabki paytda ishlashni **afzal ko'radi**.

sentences.text: These days young people **hate** talking on the phone — they **prefer** messages.
sentences.translation: Hozirgi yoshlar telefonda gaplashishni **yomon ko'radi** — xabar yozishni **afzal biladi**.

sentences.text: **Do** you **mind** if I open the window? It's quite stuffy in here.
sentences.translation: Derazani ochsam **qarshi emasmisiz**? Bu yer ancha dim.

sentences.text: Bekzod really **wants** to study abroad, but his parents **want** him to stay at home.
sentences.translation: Bekzod chet elda o'qishni juda **xohlaydi**, lekin ota-onasi uning shu yerda qolishini **istaydi**.

sentences.text: Sorry, **I don't like** horror films — can we watch a comedy instead?
sentences.translation: Kechirasiz, qo'rqinchli filmlarni **yoqtirmayman** — o'rniga komediya ko'rsak bo'ladimi?

sentences.text: Emma **loves** her new job, although it **means** getting up at five.
sentences.translation: Emma yangi ishini **juda yaxshi ko'radi**, garchi bu soat beshda turish **degani** bo'lsa ham.

sentences.text: What **do** you **need** for the trip to Khiva? — Just a hat and good shoes.
sentences.translation: Xivaga safar uchun sizga nima **kerak**? — Shlyapa va yaxshi poyabzal, xolos.

sentences.text: The doctor says Grandma **needs** rest, but she **wants** to go back to her garden.
sentences.translation: Shifokorning aytishicha, buvimga dam olish **kerak**, lekin u bog'iga qaytishni **xohlaydi**.

examples.title: Thinking verbs: **know**, **understand**, **remember**
examples.description: Bilim va fikr fe'llari — know, understand, believe, realise, mean, remember, forget, recognise, suppose — Simple da keladi.

sentences.text: **I don't understand** this instruction — what **does** it **mean**?
sentences.translation: Bu ko'rsatmani **tushunmayapman** — u nimani **anglatadi**?

sentences.text: **Do** you **remember** the name of that café in Samarkand?
sentences.translation: Samarqanddagi o'sha kafening nomini **eslaysizmi**?

sentences.text: Nobody **believes** the official explanation, because the facts **don't match**.
sentences.translation: Rasmiy tushuntirishga hech kim **ishonmayapti**, chunki faktlar bir-biriga **mos kelmaydi**.

sentences.text: Now **I realise** why everyone **recommends** this teacher so highly.
sentences.translation: Endi **anglayapman**, nega hamma bu o'qituvchini bunchalik **tavsiya qiladi**.

sentences.text: Sarah **knows** London very well because she grew up there.
sentences.translation: Sara Londonni juda yaxshi **biladi**, chunki o'sha yerda o'sgan.

sentences.text: Sorry, **I don't recognise** you — have we met before?
sentences.translation: Kechirasiz, sizni **tanimayapman** — oldin uchrashganmidik?

sentences.text: **I suppose** the shops are closed now, so let's order something online.
sentences.translation: **Menimcha**, do'konlar hozir yopiq, shunday ekan, onlayn biror narsa buyurtma qilaylik.

sentences.text: What **do** you **mean** by cheap? Under a hundred pounds?
sentences.translation: Arzon deganda nimani **nazarda tutyapsiz**? Yuz funtdan kammi?

sentences.text: Jasur often **forgets** his passwords, so he **keeps** them in a notebook.
sentences.translation: Jasur parollarini tez-tez **unutadi**, shuning uchun ularni daftarda **saqlaydi**.

sentences.text: Does anyone **know** whether the trains to Bukhara **are running** today?
sentences.translation: Bugun Buxoroga poyezdlar **qatnayaptimi**-yo'qmi, kimdir **biladimi**?

examples.title: Possession and facts: **belong**, **contain**, **depend**
examples.description: Egalik, tarkib va xususiyat fe'llari — own, belong, contain, consist of, include, cost, depend, fit, seem, deserve, weigh (og'irligi bor) — ular ham Simple.

sentences.text: This old house **belongs** to my uncle, but nobody **lives** in it now.
sentences.translation: Bu eski uy amakimga **tegishli**, lekin hozir unda hech kim **yashamaydi**.

sentences.text: The price **includes** breakfast and a guided tour of Khiva.
sentences.translation: Narxga nonushta va Xiva bo'ylab ekskursiya **kiradi**.

sentences.text: How much **does** it **cost** to fly from Tashkent to London?
sentences.translation: Toshkentdan Londonga uchish qancha **turadi**?

sentences.text: Whether we go camping or not **depends** on the weather forecast.
sentences.translation: Lagerga borish-bormasligimiz ob-havo ma'lumotiga **bog'liq**.

sentences.text: These jeans **don't fit** me any more, so I need a bigger size.
sentences.translation: Bu jinsi shim menga endi **to'g'ri kelmaydi**, kattaroq o'lcham kerak.

sentences.text: The exam **consists** of three parts: reading, writing and speaking.
sentences.translation: Imtihon uch qismdan **iborat**: o'qish, yozish va gapirish.

sentences.text: Your suitcase **weighs** twenty-five kilos, so you have to pay extra.
sentences.translation: Chamadoningiz yigirma besh kilo **keladi**, shuning uchun qo'shimcha to'lashingiz kerak.

sentences.text: It **seems** that the new manager **doesn't trust** anyone in the team.
sentences.translation: **Aftidan**, yangi menejer jamoadagi hech kimga **ishonmaydi**.

sentences.text: Kate **owns** two flats in Manchester and **rents** them both to students.
sentences.translation: Keytning Manchesterda ikkita kvartirasi **bor**, ikkalasini ham talabalarga **ijaraga beradi**.

sentences.text: You worked hard all year, so you **deserve** a proper holiday.
sentences.translation: Butun yil tinmay ishlading, shuning uchun haqiqiy ta'tilga **loyiqsan**.

examples.title: **think**: opinion or process?
examples.description: think = fikrim shunday (believe) — Simple; think = o'ylab ko'ryapman, mulohaza qilyapman — Continuous. What do you think? / What are you thinking about?

sentences.text: **I think** the new metro line **is** a big improvement for the city.
sentences.translation: **Menimcha**, yangi metro liniyasi shahar uchun katta yutuq.

sentences.text: **I'm thinking** of changing my job — the salary is too low.
sentences.translation: Ishimni o'zgartirish haqida **o'ylab yuribman** — maosh juda kam.

sentences.text: What **do** you **think** of Oliver's plan? Will it work?
sentences.translation: Oliverning rejasi haqida nima **deb o'ylaysiz**? Ish beradimi?

sentences.text: What **are** you **thinking** about? You haven't said a word for ten minutes.
sentences.translation: Nima haqida **o'ylayapsan**? O'n daqiqadan beri bir og'iz ham gapirmading.

sentences.text: Dilnoza **doesn't think** that the exam will be difficult this year.
sentences.translation: Dilnoza bu yil imtihon qiyin bo'ladi **deb o'ylamaydi**.

sentences.text: My parents **are thinking** about selling the flat and moving to the countryside.
sentences.translation: Ota-onam kvartirani sotib, qishloqqa ko'chib ketishni **o'ylab ko'rishyapti**.

sentences.text: Who **do** you **think** will win the election? — Honestly, I have no idea.
sentences.translation: **Sizningcha**, saylovda kim yutadi? — Rostini aytsam, bilmayman.

sentences.text: Be quiet for a moment — **I'm thinking**, and you're making it hard.
sentences.translation: Bir daqiqa jim tur — **o'ylayapman**, sen esa xalaqit beryapsan.

sentences.text: Tom **thinks** he's always right, which makes him difficult to work with.
sentences.translation: Tom o'zini doim haq **deb o'ylaydi**, shuning uchun u bilan ishlash qiyin.

sentences.text: We**'re thinking** of going to Edinburgh for the festival, but the tickets **seem** expensive.
sentences.translation: Festival uchun Edinburgga borishni **o'ylab turibmiz**, lekin chiptalar qimmatga **o'xshaydi**.

examples.title: **see** and **hear**: notice, understand or meet?
examples.description: see / hear — sezish (Simple, ko'pincha can bilan); I see = tushundim; see = uchrashmoq, qabuliga bormoq, biror kishi bilan yurmoq — Continuous.

sentences.text: **I can see** the mountains from my window when the air is clear.
sentences.translation: Havo tiniq bo'lganda derazamdan tog'lar **ko'rinadi**.

sentences.text: **Can** you **hear** that strange noise coming from the engine?
sentences.translation: Dvigateldan kelayotgan o'sha g'alati ovozni **eshityapsizmi**?

sentences.text: Oh, **I see** — so the meeting isn't cancelled, just moved to Friday.
sentences.translation: Ha, **tushundim** — demak, yig'ilish bekor qilinmagan, shunchaki jumaga ko'chirilgan.

sentences.text: **I'm seeing** a specialist about my back on Thursday.
sentences.translation: Payshanba kuni belim bo'yicha mutaxassis **qabuliga boraman**.

sentences.text: Aziz **is seeing** a girl from his English class — they met in September.
sentences.translation: Aziz ingliz tili guruhidagi bir qiz bilan **uchrashib yuribdi** — ular sentyabrda tanishishgan.

sentences.text: **Do** you **see** what I mean, or shall I explain it again?
sentences.translation: Nima demoqchiligimni **tushunyapsizmi** yoki yana bir bor tushuntiraymi?

sentences.text: We **hear** that you're moving to Manchester — is it true?
sentences.translation: Manchesterga ko'chib ketayotganingizni **eshitdik** — rostmi?

sentences.text: Sarah **is seeing** her old friends from university this weekend.
sentences.translation: Sara shu dam olish kunlari universitetdagi eski do'stlari bilan **ko'rishadi**.

sentences.text: Speak up, please — **I can't hear** you because of the traffic.
sentences.translation: Balandroq gapiring, iltimos — mashinalar shovqinidan sizni **eshitmayapman**.

sentences.text: Jasur **doesn't see** the point of meetings that last two hours.
sentences.translation: Jasur ikki soat davom etadigan yig'ilishlarning ma'nosini **tushunmaydi**.

examples.title: **have**: possession or activity?
examples.description: have = ega bo'lmoq, bor (holat) — Simple; have breakfast / a shower / a party / a good time / a baby / problems — harakat, Continuous mumkin.

sentences.text: Bekzod **has** three older sisters and a younger brother.
sentences.translation: Bekzodning uchta opasi va bitta ukasi **bor**.

sentences.text: Bekzod **is having** a shower — can he call you back in five minutes?
sentences.translation: Bekzod **dush qabul qilyapti** — besh daqiqadan keyin qayta qo'ng'iroq qilsa bo'ladimi?

sentences.text: We**'re having** a party on Saturday to celebrate Nilufar's new job.
sentences.translation: Nilufarning yangi ishini nishonlash uchun shanba kuni **ziyofat qilyapmiz**.

sentences.text: **Do** you **have** a minute? I need your advice about something.
sentences.translation: Bir daqiqa vaqtingiz **bormi**? Bir narsa bo'yicha maslahatingiz kerak.

sentences.text: The kids **are having** a great time at the summer camp near Chimgan.
sentences.translation: Bolalar Chimyon yaqinidagi yozgi lagerda **zo'r vaqt o'tkazishyapti**.

sentences.text: My aunt **is having** a baby in March, so the whole family is excited.
sentences.translation: Xolam martda **farzand ko'radi**, shuning uchun butun oila hayajonda.

sentences.text: Emma **has** a headache, so she**'s lying** down in a dark room.
sentences.translation: Emmaning **boshi og'riyapti**, shuning uchun qorong'i xonada **yotibdi**.

sentences.text: Sorry, we can't talk now — we**'re having** dinner with my in-laws.
sentences.translation: Kechirasiz, hozir gaplasha olmaymiz — qaynona-qaynotam bilan **kechki ovqat qilyapmiz**.

sentences.text: **Does** your flat **have** a balcony? — Yes, a small one facing the park.
sentences.translation: Kvartirangizda balkon **bormi**? — Ha, parkka qaragan kichkina balkon bor.

sentences.text: Tom **is having** problems with his new laptop, and the shop **has** no idea why.
sentences.translation: Tomning yangi noutbuki bilan **muammolari chiqyapti**, do'konda esa sababini hech kim **bilmaydi**.

examples.title: **taste**, **smell**, **look**, **feel**: state or action?
examples.description: taste / smell / feel — ta'mi, hidi, tuyulishi (Simple) yoki tatib, hidlab, ushlab ko'rmoq (Continuous). look va «his qilmoq» ma'nosidagi feel bilan ikkalasi ham mumkin.

sentences.text: This soup **tastes** a bit too salty — did you add salt twice?
sentences.translation: Bu sho'rva biroz **sho'r chiqibdi** — ikki marta tuz soldingmi?

sentences.text: Mum **is tasting** the sauce to see if it needs more pepper.
sentences.translation: Oyim qalampir yetarlimi-yo'qmi, bilish uchun qaylani **tatib ko'ryapti**.

sentences.text: The whole street **smells** of fresh bread in the early morning.
sentences.translation: Tongda butun ko'chadan yangi non **hidi anqiydi**.

sentences.text: Why **are** you **smelling** the milk? Is it past its date?
sentences.translation: Nega sutni **hidlayapsan**? Muddati o'tib ketganmi?

sentences.text: You **look** tired, Jasur. **Are** you **sleeping** enough?
sentences.translation: **Charchaganga o'xshaysan**, Jasur. Yetarlicha **uxlayapsanmi**?

sentences.text: You**'re looking** great — have you started going to the gym?
sentences.translation: **Zo'r ko'rinyapsan** — sport zaliga qatnay boshladingmi?

sentences.text: How **are** you **feeling** after the operation? — Much better, thanks.
sentences.translation: Operatsiyadan keyin o'zingizni qanday **his qilyapsiz**? — Ancha yaxshi, rahmat.

sentences.text: How **do** you **feel** about working night shifts?
sentences.translation: Tungi smenada ishlashga qanday **qaraysiz**?

sentences.text: This fabric **feels** soft, but it **looks** rather cheap.
sentences.translation: Bu mato ushlab ko'rsang **mayin**, lekin ko'rinishi ancha **arzon**.

sentences.text: The doctor **is feeling** Madina's wrist to check her pulse.
sentences.translation: Shifokor tomir urishini tekshirish uchun Madinaning bilagini **ushlab ko'ryapti**.

examples.title: Mixed: **is** rude or **is being** rude?
examples.description: be — xarakter (Simple), be + -ing — hozirgi xatti-harakat (silly, rude, careful, kind). Oxirgi gaplarda darsning barcha fe'llari aralash.

sentences.text: Oliver **is** usually very polite, so why **is** he **being** so rude today?
sentences.translation: Oliver odatda juda xushmuomala, nega u bugun bunchalik **qo'pollik qilyapti**?

sentences.text: You**'re being** silly — nobody **is laughing** at you.
sentences.translation: **Bema'nilik qilyapsan** — hech kim ustingdan **kulmayapti**.

sentences.text: The children **are being** very quiet. What **are** they **doing** upstairs?
sentences.translation: Bolalar negadir juda **jimib qolishdi**. Tepada nima **qilishyapti**?

sentences.text: Thanks for helping — you**'re being** very kind, and I really **appreciate** it.
sentences.translation: Yordam berganingiz uchun rahmat — juda **mehribonlik qilyapsiz**, buni chindan ham **qadrlayman**.

sentences.text: My brother **is** lazy by nature, but this month he**'s being** very hard-working.
sentences.translation: Akam tabiatan **dangasa**, lekin bu oy juda **tirishqoqlik qilyapti**.

sentences.text: **I'm not being** difficult — I just **want** to understand the rules.
sentences.translation: **Injiqlik qilayotganim yo'q** — shunchaki qoidalarni tushunishni **xohlayman**.

sentences.text: Kate **has** a lot of experience, so she **knows** what the client **wants**.
sentences.translation: Keytning tajribasi **katta**, shuning uchun mijoz nima **xohlashini biladi**.

sentences.text: **I'm thinking** about the offer, but **I believe** everything **depends** on the salary.
sentences.translation: Taklifni **o'ylab ko'ryapman**, lekin **menimcha**, hammasi maoshga **bog'liq**.

sentences.text: Nilufar **is having** lunch with a client, and she **doesn't want** to be disturbed.
sentences.translation: Nilufar mijoz bilan **tushlik qilyapti** va uni bezovta qilishlarini **xohlamaydi**.

sentences.text: This coffee **smells** wonderful, but it **tastes** much weaker than it **looks**.
sentences.translation: Bu qahvaning **hidi** ajoyib, lekin **ta'mi** ko'rinishidagidan ancha **bo'sh**.
